title: notification.requested payload
description:
Payload for `*.notification.requested` events consumed by abeon-notifications. Per ADR-0006.

Not discoverable, deliberately. `SchemaDiscovery` keys the catalog by file name and `RoutingKey` refuses a wildcard, so `*.notification.requested` cannot be a file name here — it is a *subscription* pattern, not a publishable key. Each emitting service publishes `{service}.notification.requested` and should ship its own copy of this payload schema under that name; this file is the shared definition they copy, and the reason it keeps a human-readable name rather than a routing-key one.
